method: Three passes as requested. Each pass builds on the previous one; the findings below are the real defects/gaps found and what was done.

pass_1_implement_and_verify.scope: Review repo; reproduce and explain the portal error; restore data autonomously; run the pre-registered designed factorial; study why 0.2477 won; rank and validate hypotheses; build verified downloads, executive guide, site, registries, feed and CI.
done: Reviewed the old GEMSDOE25 tree and the owner's sibling repos (GEMSDOE24 evidence); found the invented-footprint file (IR-25-NAN-FOOTPRINT/-OVER-EMISSION/-FAKE-PIPELINE/-DTI-KERNEL).

Data placement solved: scripts/restore_data.py restores 419 MB raster + labels + template + external layers from the owner's public repos with SHA-256 pins (end-to-end run from an empty directory: 20 s).
Pre-registered (04, 05) then executed 2^(5-1) Resolution V factorial (16 runs x 8 cells, 31 min) and add-on / emission tests; confirmation replicate with fresh draws.
Forensics of the scored rasters: 0.2477 file == dot_thin(H19-5, 1.5) pixel-for-pixel; lattice and live pair give |G| 12.5k / 12.8k; out-of-sample check on the H25/H28 pair.

Local writer/checker reproduces the owner-mirrored 0.2477-labelled raster's pixels and profile; the D2.8 file is byte-identical to an owner-mirrored unscored alternate. Neither file's organizer acceptance or score was verified.
Site (root index.html + 3 sub-pages), README with the verbatim brief, AGENTS.md, AI_DISCLOSURE.md, registries, ToS-compliant feed script + workflows.

found_and_fixed: ruff found an f-string with nested same-type quotes that is a SyntaxError on Python 3.11 (this sandbox's version) in scripts/build_site.py: fixed (twice, the second time in code added later).
A claim of 'Spearman 1.000' between the training tc band and GeoDAWN TC was a rounding of 0.9999: corrected in registry and docstring.

'byte-for-byte' was used where only mask equality had been verified: reworded to 'pixel-for-pixel', then 'byte-identical' used only after the full SHA-256 of the re-written D2.8 file matched the group's file.
The verbatim brief file had abbreviated the second (identical) copy of the results list: restored in full so the README copy really is verbatim.

Executive page showed an informational check ('strict whole-array check fails for any NaN') as a red FAIL, mislabelled the zeros fallback as 'NaN outside', and implied a declared exception was needed although the gate passed: all fixed, plus provenance wording ('pinned organizer grid' -> expected grid/footprint of the owner's mirror).
File name said d2-4 while note and site said D2.8 (same pixel set): renamed to d2-8 to match the group's naming.
Preview server initially served the whole repo including .git: restarted on a site-only directory.
Plain requests cannot reach api.github.com from the sandbox: feed script falls back to the authenticated gh CLI so the committed seed feed is real data.
Old broken TIFs were still in docs/downloads: removed, with a regression test that they are neither shipped nor linked.
Experiments are deterministic: two logged cells re-run from scratch reproduced DTI to 1e-9.
Hidden-components design checked for leakage (collar, whole-component hiding, visible-only catalogue features, labels never used for GDR points) and covered by tests.
known_residual_risks: Hide-and-recover is a catalogue-gap proxy; the harness scores the H19 family ~2.7x lower than live while reproducing the blind lattice within ~5 % (IR-25-PROXY-LIMITS).
Family E very likely flatters the proxy; the +ALL add-on gain is weakly supported (t = 1.97, 3 d.f.).
The dotting model's out-of-sample error is -0.017, larger than the predicted +0.008 gain of D2.8 over D1.5.

pass_3_recheck_against_the_original_brie.method: Re-read the brief line by line (README, 'Owner brief (verbatim)') and mapped each requirement to an artefact.

done: Reviewed current feature families and ranked four fresh, repository-distinct geology hypotheses in knowledge/09 before implementing H27-1; documented official pages and direct-binary limitations.
Implemented visible-catalogue directed endpoint continuation, cross-scale DEM/LiDAR scarp support, an explicit T×S feature, a randomized 2² runner, and contrast/gate analysis.

Ran the frozen H27 screen on draws 4,5 across four spatial folds (32 complete cells). Results: T +0.008120, S -0.000196, T×S -0.001622; combined TS DTI 0.151064 vs historical holdout best 0.152003389.

Paired TS-vs-base criteria passed (+0.007924; 4/4 folds; worst +0.002447; hug-share +0.0123), but the required absolute comparator failed. Per preregistration, no confirmation was run, no H27 TIFF was packaged, and no slot was used.
Updated generated README/site, score/source/evidence records and the executive guide to distinguish format validation from holdout/slot eligibility.

Re-audited score provenance: local pixel identity for the 0.2477-labelled raster is reproducible, but 0.2477 and 0.3195 remain user/owner-provided, unverified claims; updated the analysis generator, conditional model, evidence JSON, registries and site wording so no owner mirror is presented as organizer evidence.

Regenerated the submission package, site and README. The primary D2.8 GeoTIFF passes all hard local format checks against the owner-mirror template; its note now explicitly says it is not holdout-promoted and no slot is approved.
Refreshed the source feed after redirect-policy hardening: 49 items, 24 reachable; DrivenData remains excluded from automatic requests.

found_and_fixed: Source-feed redirect review found requests could auto-follow redirects in the HEAD-to-GET fallback, ScienceBase JSON and GitHub API paths. Added a shared manual redirect policy and regression tests proving a DrivenData redirect target is not requested.
README called already-run H26 hypotheses “not yet tried”; changed to historical outcomes and added the current H27 register/results.

Site previously suggested spending weekly slots on unvalidated D2.8/exploratory files and treated a shared-mask diagnostic as a holdout gate. Removed the slot suggestion; both available surfaces are explicitly not slot-approved until a specific candidate beats 0.152003389 under the frozen holdout rule.

Existing score ledger implied that user-provided 0.2477 and 0.3195 were independently verified. Marked them unverified, corrected the leaderboard source record, and separated local pixel-identity verification from competition-score verification.
Added tests for directed endpoint behavior, edge-clipped traces, empty catalogues, 2² contrasts, strict promotion gating, and redirect chains.

Found stale 'portal accepted/live score' wording and organizer-template attribution in historical evidence/tests; corrected it to distinguish local file identity and owner-mirror checks from unverified organizer score/file identity.

Found an unregistered, still-tracked BDE+X1–X3 GeoTIFF whose proxy score only equalled the current 0.152003389 comparator; removed the stale downloadable artifact and added an integrity test requiring every shipped TIF to be registered and every current item to remain not slot-approved.

Closed the optional exploratory-package bypass: packaging now fails closed unless a receipt records a passed fresh confirmation above the current holdout best and binds the gate to the exact TIFF SHA-256; added tests for missing, failed, tied, mismatched, non-finite and malformed receipts.
Made the generated submission note itself state 'not holdout-promoted vs 0.152003389 | no slot' within the 120-character limit.

Final edge review found the directed-tip feature could mutate its caller's boolean catalogue and accept fractional chunk sizes/indices through coercion; copied inputs, required integer indices/positive integer chunks, and added regressions.

Post-deployment guide review caught the zeros-outside fallback's comment being truncated mid-word at the 120-character cap; now generate it with the same bounded note builder and test both primary/fallback notes for complete holdout/no-slot wording.
open_limitations: GDR probe/paleo and USGS heat-flow binaries remain unavailable from this sandbox; source-page listings are not data validation.
The H27 T-only screen arm exceeded the historical comparator, but it was not the preregistered combined promotion arm and has no independent confirmation; no post-hoc promotion is allowed.
The competition DTI claims and owner-mirror data authenticity remain unverified.
The owner-mirrored competition template/data are not organizer-authenticated; local GeoTIFF checks establish internal format consistency only.
No organizer score receipt/page was accessed; the 0.2477 and 0.3195 claims and all other owner-reported DTI anchors remain unverified.
